claims.text: Equimolar WTaTiVZr has enhanced high-temperature plastic strain and toughness relative to commercially pure tungsten.
The multielement composition of WTaTiVZr chemically stabilizes and refines its grain boundaries through solute drag.
Solute-drag-mediated grain-boundary stabilization promotes dynamic recrystallization in WTaTiVZr.
Solute-drag-mediated grain-boundary stabilization promotes grain-boundary sliding in WTaTiVZr.
Dynamic recrystallization and grain-boundary sliding reduce brittle intergranular failure in WTaTiVZr relative to pure tungsten.
Identical thermomechanical treatments can produce comparable coarse grain sizes in WTaTiVZr and pure tungsten.
The refractory constituent elements of WTaTiVZr are low-activation elements.
Solute atoms enrich the grain boundaries of WTaTiVZr.
Testing at 1000–1300 °C represents high-temperature plasma-facing-component service conditions.
Multielement segregation creates a chemically and structurally refined grain-boundary region in WTaTiVZr.
The refined grain-boundary structure enhances grain-boundary sliding during high-temperature deformation.
The refined grain-boundary structure facilitates dynamic recrystallization during high-temperature deformation.
Dynamic recrystallization can govern high-temperature flow behavior in a refractory multicomponent alloy at 1000–1200 °C.
WTaTiVZr will show more dynamic recrystallization and grain-boundary migration than pure tungsten under identical conditions.
WTaTiVZr will have improved creep resistance, greater plastic strain, and higher fracture toughness than pure tungsten.
Grain-boundary solute enrichment in WTaTiVZr will correlate with its mechanical benefits.
Pure tungsten subjected to the same thermomechanical treatment will have coarser, chemically homogeneous grain boundaries, limited grain-boundary sliding, and earlier intergranular cracking.
Processing changes that substantially alter grain size or induce additional phases can invalidate the proposed mechanism.
Heat treatment can trigger recovery, recrystallization, grain growth, and secondary-phase precipitation that may promote brittleness.

Failure to observe enhanced grain-boundary sliding or dynamic recrystallization, or failure to detect grain-boundary enrichment despite mechanical benefits, would falsify the proposed grain-boundary-chemistry mechanism.

contradictions.description: The initial-state field says the two materials are processed to have comparable coarse grain sizes, whereas the baseline predicts that identically processed pure tungsten will have coarser grain boundaries.
